messages.author: ab076a7b9dcd86cb
messages.subject: Re: Help problem with rJava
parts:
Make sure your version (32 vs 64-bit)of Java matches the version of R you are using.  I don't remember what I did to fix it, but I'm pretty sure this is what is came down to.  

http://java.com/en/download/manual.jsp has both 32-bit and 64-bit versions. They can coexist side-by-side, so I think I just installed the 64-bit version and that cleaned it up.
